description: The foundational lower body compound movement training knee flexion, hip mobility, and quadricep and glute power.
setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out (5-15 degrees), and chest elevated.
steps: Initiate movement by sending hips back and bending knees simultaneously.
Descend until hip crease dips level with or slightly below knees.
Drive feet into the ground and extend knees and hips to return to tall standing position.
cues: Track knees out in line with toes
Keep full foot planted with weight balanced over midfoot

mistakes.fix: Actively push knees outward against an imaginary resistance band

mistakes.mistake: Heels lifting off floor during descent
mistakes.fix: Screw feet into the ground and shift center of mass slightly into midfoot and heel

rep_standard: Hip crease breaks parallel with top of knees at bottom, full hip and knee lockout at top
